_comment: The Graviturge tree for the demo (PROPOSED names; the discipline itself is canon: 'which way is down, and how hard', limited by gravitational debt). Points: start_points, plus awards for learning a word, finishing a quest and felling a guardian. One keystone per character. Mods: keys ending in _mult multiply, others add. Consumed keys: debt_cost_mult, debt_repay_mult, damage_mult, slam_radius_mult, slam_damage_mult, slam_debt, fall_damage_mult, knockback_taken_mult, hp_max_mult, stamina_max_mult, stamina_regen_mult, damage_taken_mult. x/y place the node in the tree view: the root at 0,0, branches going up.
name: Graviturge

nodes.name: Sense of Down
nodes.text: You feel which way is down. Words cost 10% less debt.

nodes.name: Heavy Hand
nodes.text: Your blows carry more weight. 10% more melee damage.

nodes.name: Anchor Stance
nodes.text: You are hard to move. Knockback against you is halved.

nodes.name: Borrowed Weight
nodes.text: Keystone. Every slam borrows weight: slams strike twice as hard and 15% more melee damage, but each slam adds 8 debt.

nodes.name: Deep Credit
nodes.text: Keystone. Words cost 35% less debt, but debt drains 30% slower.

nodes.name: Featherfall
nodes.text: Keystone. Falls never hurt you, but you take 10% more damage from everything else.
